_comment: BURN-DOWN list for the size check in checks.mjs: files already over the limit when it was added. The list may only ever shrink. The gate fails three ways: a file over the limit that is not listed here, a listed file that has grown past the number recorded for it, and a listed file that no longer needs to be listed. Never add an entry to make a red check green -- take the smallest thing in the file out into its own file instead. Every entry says what will split it and stays until that happens.

api/desk.js.note: The desk actions about the person in front of you, plus the two lists that find them. Every subject with a shape of its own has moved out: the page, the quotes, the write helpers, the introductions, the drafting, the plan, the funnel, the demo records. Recorded 2026-10-01.

test/database.test.mjs.note: The query tests, grouped by subject with a console heading per group. The harness and the two endpoint-driven groups are out already (test/harness.mjs, test/db-screens.test.mjs); the rest splits along the same headings as each one grows. Recorded 2026-09-30.
